name: Sakakibara Nene
source:
After losing a game, she was made to ride the rumored molester train by her friends as a penalty. Thinking it was just a made-up story, she went ahead and rode the train. At first, nothing happened so she went and rode it again. Eventually, a hand reached out to her...

She told her classmates that nothing happened, but actually, she's now looking forward to being pleasured inside that train...

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=856530]Getchu[/url]]
